text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is my moment, the race that will
help me
grow...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll win without breaking a sweat,
refining
myself
even further!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do it all with the power of
speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've learned a new phrase recently... let
me teach
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Like a bolt from the blue!" It basically
means
something surprising happens!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It resonated with me! I'll be there to
astound them
all! Be prepared for some
lightning-fast speed!
